# Focaccia

A wetter dough than the [[Weekend Loaf]], baked in a tin for picnics.

## Dough

- 500 g bread flour
- 400 g water (80 percent hydration)
- 50 g starter from [[Sourdough Starter]]
- 12 g salt
- A good glug of olive oil in the tin

## Method

No kneading. Four coil folds over two hours, then into the oiled tin and into the fridge for 24 hours. Dimple hard with oily fingers, top with rosemary and flaky salt, bake at 230 C for 25 minutes.

## Notes

The cold proof matters more than the hydration here. When I skipped the fridge the crumb was tight and bland. Cherry tomatoes on top go soggy unless they are halved and salted first.
